title: A photo diary with no ratings of food
description: A photo and an optional note about a meal. Looking through the history without calories, points or ratings of dishes.

blocks.text: A reviewer needs a simple way to record food without the usual calorie counting. The absence of a rating in numbers can be the reason for choosing it here, not a shortcoming of the product.

quote.text: As someone who has a poor relationship with calorie counting but want to easily track what i eat for my diet, this app has been amazing for my needs! I’ve been using it for over a year now and i love it!

blocks.text: Save a meal without required numbers

A photo, the time and an optional note make up an entry. You can come back to it, correct the description and gather a chosen period for your own review or for a conversation. Don’t require calories or a rating of the dish to finish the entry.
Test how convenient your own scenario is

What matters is whether the person manages to save regularly what they wanted to record, and to find it later. A photo diary should not be described as a treatment for a difficult relationship with food or as a universal replacement for other kinds of observation.
